title: Dragon Vortex Sorcerer
description: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a large, iridescent teal and purple dragon with a glowing orange vortex emerging from its open mouth. In the foreground, a green humanoid figure stands on the dragon's coiled body with one arm raised, while a smaller dark silhouette stands further back. The dragon's tail wraps around a large transparent sphere containing floating colored orbs.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a massive iridescent teal dragon coiled through a dreamlike landscape, its head turned toward a swirling glowing orange and cyan vortex emerging from its mouth. A vibrant green humanoid figure stands on the dragon's back with arm raised, while a smaller black silhouette stands behind. The dragon's body wraps around a large transparent sphere with floating pink and orange circles inside. Colorful flowers grow along the path, with a giant dripping tree and dark mountains in the background under a purple sky with a glowing moon, vibrant dripping paint effects
